support.score_rows: exact frozen 0069 final-window P02 timestamps only
support.common_rows: identical rows for benchmark, six candidates and two controls
support.start: first row with P02, next SOL return, causal DTB3 and 20 lagged SOL returns
support.end: last P02 row having next SOL return

controllers.C05_DRAWDOWN_AWARE: clip(1-score,0,1)*overlay where lagged SOL benchmark drawdown <10%=>1.0, 10-20%=>0.75, 20-30%=>0.50, >=30%=>0.25
controllers.C06_HYSTERESIS: initial risk-on=1; score>=0.60=>0; score<=0.40=>1; otherwise carry prior state

metrics.cost_drag: C0 terminal NAV minus cost-state terminal NAV
metrics.recovery_time: maximum sessions from drawdown start to prior high recovery, null if unrecovered

regime_diagnostics: trailing 60-session SOL compounded return known at t: bull>20%, bear<-20%, sideways otherwise; diagnostic only

cost_break_even.target: candidate terminal NAV equals benchmark terminal NAV

bootstrap.method: synchronized moving-block bootstrap of common row indices

DSR.definition: Bailey-Lopez_de_Prado deflated Sharpe probability using observed Sharpe, T, skewness, Pearson kurtosis and expected maximum Sharpe over six trials

concentration.stress: remove candidate best C1 calendar month and same month from benchmark

matched_attribution.return_gate: if control CAGR>0 candidate CAGR>=0.95*control CAGR else candidate CAGR>=control CAGR
need_two_of_three: if control worst20<0 candidate worst20>=control worst20+0.05*abs(control worst20) else candidate worst20>=control worst20

pass_gates.G1: 6 candidates + 2 controls + benchmark complete; frozen counts; no lookahead
pass_gates.G2: C1: if benchmark CAGR>0 candidate CAGR/benchmark CAGR>=0.75 else candidate CAGR>=benchmark CAGR
pass_gates.G4: C1: if benchmark worst20<0 candidate worst20>=benchmark worst20+0.10*abs(benchmark worst20) else candidate worst20>=benchmark worst20
pass_gates.G5: C1 candidate Sharpe>=benchmark Sharpe and DSR>=0.95
pass_gates.G7: C2: return retention>=0.70 when benchmark CAGR>0 otherwise candidate>=benchmark; MDD magnitude<=0.85 benchmark; worst20 loss improves>=5% when benchmark worst20<0
pass_gates.G8: best-month removal: return retention>=0.70 when benchmark positive otherwise candidate>=benchmark; MDD magnitude<=0.90 benchmark
pass_gates.G9: MBB probability candidate MDD magnitude smaller than benchmark>=0.95 and probability G2 return condition holds>=0.90
pass_gates.G10: C04/C05 only: matched attribution gate passes

pareto.representative_if_multiple: lowest C1 MDD magnitude, then lower C1 turnover, then lexical candidate id

classification.PASS_LOCKED_P02_ECONOMIC_CONTROLLER_INTE: valid, common rows>=252, at least one candidate passes all gates
classification.FAIL_NO_ROBUST_LOCKED_P02_ECONOMIC_CONTR: valid sufficient support, no candidate passes all gates
classification.MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_EC: valid accounting but common rows<252 or required inference undefined
